summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title), gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests and mypy are unverified; the work was checked by reading only.
